solution.title: Cisco ISE Device Compliance & Posture Integration with Intune (MDM Compliance Connector)

products.name: Cisco ISE Device Compliance & Posture Integration with Intune (MDM Compliance Connector) — Commercial
products.short_description: Wire Cisco ISE to Intune via the MDM compliance connector so ISE gates VPN and network access on real-time device compliance and enrollment — the posture/NAC layer, deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Let Cisco ISE gate network access on Intune device compliance

A device can hold a valid certificate and still be non-compliant — unencrypted, out of date, jailbroken. This solution wires Cisco ISE to Microsoft Intune through the MDM compliance connector so ISE queries each device's real-time enrollment and compliance state and gates VPN and network access on it — the posture / NAC piece that turns compliance policy into enforced access, deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how ISE-to-Intune posture works: the Entra app registration ISE uses, the MDM compliance connection, the compliance and enrollment signals ISE reads, and how they map to authorization / access rules.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune compliance policies in place, an Entra app registration with the right Graph permissions, ISE licensing/version for MDM, network reachability, a pilot group) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps to register the app in Entra, connect ISE to Intune, define named compliance policies, map them to ISE authorization, assign to a pilot, and validate that non-compliant devices are denied, then expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — connector-readiness discovery, per-device compliance/enrollment validation, a compliance-coverage and access-decision report, safe remediation of non-compliant devices, and a target-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates (registered, compliant, access granted; non-compliant, access denied), plus Best Practices for grace and remediation.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Network and VPN access granted only to devices Intune says are compliant and enrolled — enforced by Cisco ISE, and proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • ISEPOST-Discovery.ps1 — connector readiness: the Entra app registration ISE uses, its Graph permissions/secret, and the Intune compliance policies
    • ISEPOST-Remediation.ps1 — safely nudge non-compliant devices toward compliance (default -WhatIf; nothing changes until -Execute)
    • ISEPOST-Report.ps1 — fleet compliance-coverage report plus a conceptual access-decision (granted vs denied) breakdown
    • ISEPOST-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — create and populate the pilot / expansion Entra group(s) used for staged rollout
    • ISEPOST-Validation.ps1 — confirm THIS device's compliance + enrollment state exactly as Cisco ISE would read it from Intune

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
